## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

DesignTokens.Typography.Watch — app-wear/src/main/java/com/mgilli/app_wear/ui/theme/DesignTokens.kt

## Trigger

Rendering any Text composable on the watch that reads a
DesignTokens.Typography.Watch token as its fontSize — observed. Every
read site (WaitingForPhoneScreen, ProjectionScreen, PreparationScreen,
HomeScreen, ControlScreen, MainRacePageScreen, WatchHistoryScreen,
EndOfRaceScreen, SensorPermissionScreen) sits inside a `@Composable`
function already, so a run-time source such as `LocalConfiguration` or
`LocalDensity` is reachable from every one of them without changing
their surrounding scope.

## Today

`DesignTokens.Typography.Watch` declares nine constants — `display`
110, `displaySm` 80, `value` 48, `valueSm` 40, `badge` 37, `title` 33,
`label` 24, `labelSm` 20, `caption` 18 — each typed as a plain `.sp`
`TextUnit` (`DesignTokens.kt:76-86`), matched one-for-one by
`DesignTokensTest.kt:64-74`, which asserts the same nine `.sp` values.
Every watch screen reads one of these constants directly as
`fontSize` — around fifty call sites across nine screens (grep above).
`.sp` is a scaled pixel, not a pixel: on the 340 dpi / 480×480 face the
conversion multiplies by roughly 2.125, so `Watch.display` draws at
about 234 px instead of the 110 px the spec's type scale names, and
every other Watch token is inflated the same way. Nothing in
`DesignTokens.kt`, `MainActivity.kt` or any screen file reads the
face's actual width (`LocalConfiguration`, `LocalDensity`, or
equivalent) to turn a pixel figure into a size proportional to it —
the constants are fixed at compile time and carry no run-time
resolution at all.

## Expected

Each `DesignTokens.Typography.Watch` token keeps its numeric value
from the spec's type scale (110, 80, 48, 40, 37, 33, 24, 20, 18) but
stops being a static `.sp` constant. It resolves at render time from
the watch's own face width — a token of N pixels renders at N times
(actual face width in pixels / 480), converted to the `sp` a
`Text`'s `fontSize` expects, so the same proportions hold on any
watch, not only a 480 px, 340 dpi face. Because every call site
already runs inside a `@Composable`, the token can become a
`@Composable` function (or read a `CompositionLocal` supplying the
resolved value) without moving any call site out of composition —
only the nine constants in `DesignTokens.kt` and their read sites'
call syntax change from property access to a resolved read; no
caller needs a value it cannot supply today.
